Following the walkover, Leylah Fernandez is scheduled to compete against Kamilla Rakhimova from Russia to secure a spot in the final round. Despite her current withdrawal in Tokyo, Rybakina is anticipated to recover in time to participate in the upcoming season-ending WTA Finals, which will be held next month in Indian Wells, California.

stories.title: New Gas Pricing Bill Reaches Senate Amid Controversy
stories.summary:
A legislative measure proposing quarterly determinations for natural gas pricing was introduced in the upper House of Parliament on Friday, triggering fresh controversy. Minister of State for Interior Tallal Chaudhry presented the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra) (Amendment) Bill, 2026, to the Senate amid widespread public criticism over unpredictable daily fuel pricing mechanisms and frequent price shocks.

The bill proposes adding a new Section 8A to the Ogra Ordinance of 2002. Under this framework, natural gas licensees would submit total revenue requirements quarterly—focusing strictly on wellhead gas costs and imported gas expenses, including Re-Gasified Liquefied Natural Gas (RLNG)—for review. Ogra would subsequently advise the federal government, which must then establish minimum charges and sale prices for retail consumer categories within 30 days for gazette notification. Additionally, the legislation grants the government authority to carry forward quarterly adjustments into upcoming half-yearly determinations, while amending Section 9 to eliminate public hearings for price revisions under Section 8A. Proponents state the bill aims to align tariffs with market realities, adjust for Rupee-Dollar parity, and curb circular debt.

During the Senate session, the bill's arrival coincided with a debate raised by PPP Senator Waqar Mehdi regarding the proposed relocation of Pakistan Petroleum Limited’s (PPL) head office from Karachi to Islamabad. Mehdi warned against moving federal institutions away from Karachi, noting the current office costs about Rs4 million monthly while relocation would cost billions and disrupt approximately 500 Sindh-based employees. Senator Zamir Ghumro questioned the legality of moving the office without approval from the Council of Common Interests. Responding to the concerns, Minister Chaudhry defended the move, stating PPL's board deemed vacation inevitable and that the company's assets span multiple provinces without affecting employees.

stories.title: Helicopter Crash in Uttarakhand Kills Six People On Board
stories.summary:
A tragic helicopter crash in the Indian Himalayan state of Uttarakhand resulted in the deaths of all six people on board on Friday. According to Prateek Jain, Chief Executive Officer of the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA), the victims included five passengers and the pilot.

The aircraft was traveling from Badrinath, a prominent Hindu pilgrimage site located in the mountains, toward the city of Dehradun. UCADA reported that the helicopter lost communication while flying over the Joshimath valley, at which point tracking systems could no longer monitor its location. Television broadcasts showed fire and smoke at the crash site, prompting immediate deployment of rescue teams.

In response to the tragedy, authorities initiated a joint search and rescue operation involving the district administration, disaster management teams, and local troops. Additionally, the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority announced that the entire fleet belonging to the operator, Trans Bharat Aviation, has been grounded as a precautionary measure while investigations proceed.

stories.title: India halts Sun Pharma eye-care drug production at Assam plant
stories.summary:
Indian drug regulators ordered Sun Pharmaceutical Industries to halt the production, sale, and distribution of ophthalmic products at its Assam facility. The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation and the office of Drugs Controller Assam issued the shutdown order on August 20 following a joint federal-state inspection that uncovered failures in the facility's quality management system. This regulatory action follows Sun Pharma's voluntary recall in July of roughly 11 eye-care brands, including about 332 batches of ophthalmic suspension products like Lotepred 1% 5ml eye drops, Nepalact OD, Nepalact-Z, Brinzotim 5ml, and Depopred 2ml. These drops are used to treat chronic eye conditions, infections, and inflammation.

Regulators initially issued a show-cause notice to the company on August 10 due to the quality system failures. Dissatisfied with the response, authorities escalated enforcement by halting operations at the Kokjhar village plant in Assam, which Sun Pharma had previously identified as a major future hub for sterile products. The company has submitted a compliance report that is currently under review by regulators. Although ophthalmology accounts for approximately 3% of Sun Pharma's domestic revenue and serves as a key area for the United States, the company did not respond to media requests for comment regarding the recall or the plant closure.

The crackdown coincides with heightened domestic and international scrutiny of Indian drug standards following incidents where locally produced cough syrups were linked to child deaths in Gambia, Uzbekistan, and India. Additionally, the All India Ophthalmological Society issued a patient-safety advisory in June warning of contaminated batches of Predmet eye drops, which Sun Pharma also recalled. Industry experts estimate the affected batches could encompass hundreds of thousands of bottles. This enforcement action marks another setback for Sun Pharma's sterile manufacturing network, following a previous US Food and Drug Administration shipment halt at its Halol plant in Gujarat due to contamination control shortcomings.

stories.title: Pakistan abolishes five-year age limit on commercial used car imports
stories.summary:
Pakistan announced the removal of the five-year age limit on the commercial import of used vehicles, effective July 1, 2026. According to the Ministry of Commerce, the federal cabinet approved the policy shift, meaning the restriction will no longer apply after June 30, 2026. The ministry clarified this decision in response to an October 23, 2026 memorandum from the Federal Board of Revenue. Despite the removal of the age restriction, commercial imports must still fulfill existing import policy requirements alongside applicable safety and environmental standards.

In conjunction with these vehicle import changes, the government is reportedly preparing a mini-budget to introduce tax measures under a new automotive policy. Proposed plans include granting electric vehicles valued up to $75,000 sales tax relief amounting to Rs85 billion by maintaining a 1% sales tax, despite an International Monetary Fund demand to increase it to 18%. To offset the resulting tax shortfall, the government plans to introduce a finance bill establishing an Automotive Development Levy and a Federal Excise Duty.

Under the proposed auto framework, an Automotive Development Levy will target all locally assembled and imported petrol and internal combustion engine vehicles. A 2% levy will apply to engines between 1,001cc and 2,000cc, while a 10% levy will apply to engines of 2,001cc and above. Additionally, a 10% Federal Excise Duty is slated for electric vehicles priced above Rs20 million. The government also projects collecting Rs25 billion from a new carbon levy on petrol, diesel, and internal combustion vehicles, alongside general levies expected to generate Rs37 billion.

stories.title: Eleven Freed Pakistani Fishermen Return to Families in Karachi After Years in Indian Jails
stories.summary:
Eleven Pakistani fishermen, imprisoned in India for years after inadvertently crossing maritime borders, were reunited with their families in Karachi on Friday morning. The men had been handed over by Indian authorities at the Wagah Border roughly two months prior and were transported from Lahore to Karachi via an ambulance provided by the Edhi Foundation. They arrived at the Edhi Centre near Merewether Tower, where relatives had gathered since the early hours.

Having spent between three and a half and nine years behind bars, the returning men shared harrowing accounts of their captivity. Kamal Hassan Bengali of Machhar Colony, who was jailed for eight years due to an engine failure that drifted his boat into Indian waters, learned of his mother's passing through a letter that arrived three years after her death. Other fishermen, such as Abdul Rehman of Korangi and Noor Nabi Bengali, recounted enduring months of poor food quality, severe isolation, and harsh treatment by jail staff that constantly reminded them they were in an enemy territory. Khamiso Siddiq Mallah, aged 60, declared that he would never return to the sea, opting instead to work as a laborer.

The emotional reunions highlighted ongoing difficulties faced by local fishing communities. While some returnees, like Basheer, planned to resume fishing exclusively in waters off Balochistan that do not border India, others continued to search for missing relatives. Saleem Sabro attended the gathering in hopes of locating his brother Ahmed Ali, who remains unaccounted for in an Indian prison despite serving his sentence two years ago. According to Fatima Majeed Motani, Chairperson of the Fishermen’s Cooperative Society, more than 70 Pakistani fishermen remain incarcerated in India after accidentally crossing the border.

stories.title: Trump Predicts Swift Conclusion to War With Iran Ahead of Midterms
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump stated on Friday that he anticipates the ongoing conflict with Iran will conclude in the near future. Speaking on Kansas City radio station KCMO ahead of the November 3 midterm congressional elections, Trump offered his prediction about the timeline of the war without specifying the exact method by which it would end.

During the interview, the president emphasized the necessity of obtaining a definitive assurance that Iran will never acquire a nuclear weapon. The remarks come as part of his public commentary regarding regional security and U.S. foreign policy leading up to the upcoming congressional contests.

Trump previously assured the public that the United States would refrain from launching military strikes against Iran prior to the midterm elections. The administration continues to monitor the situation closely as diplomatic and security discussions persist.

The ongoing developments regarding the conflict remain a focal point of domestic and international attention as election day approaches. Further details on how the administration plans to achieve its stated objectives regarding Iran have not yet been disclosed.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Assembly Could Return Within Two Months, Predicts Marwat
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) National Assembly member Sher Afzal Marwat asserted on Friday that the federal government faces a binary choice regarding the political leadership in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Speaking exclusively to ARY News, Marwat stated that authorities must either disqualify Sohail Afridi as the province's Chief Minister or reinstate former chief minister Ali Amin Gandapur.

Marwat claimed that the eventual expiration of governor’s rule in the province could lead to the restoration of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Assembly within two months. He cautioned that the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz (PML-N) would ultimately bear the political fallout resulting from the imposition of governor's rule in the region. Furthermore, he noted that a government headed by Gandapur could potentially cause deeper internal divisions within the PTI.

Addressing the broader political landscape, Marwat criticized Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman. He characterized the Maulana as a political actor who consistently functions as a pressure group and abandons political allies once his immediate objectives are secured.

The statements by the PTI leader highlight ongoing tensions and strategic maneuvers among political parties in Pakistan concerning provincial governance and federal relations. The potential shifts in leadership and assembly status continue to be a central topic of discussion in national politics.

stories.title: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Fall for Seventh Consecutive Week
stories.summary:
India's foreign exchange reserves dropped to a more than two-month low of $719.75 billion for the week ending October 23, 2026. This marked the seventh straight week of declines, driven by the central bank's efforts to absorb oil-linked dollar demand and interventions in the market to support the rupee.

Week-on-week, the total reserves decreased by $1.27 billion. This reduction was primarily caused by a drop in the value of the Reserve Bank of India’s gold holdings, which fell by $2.6 billion to stand at $103.1 billion. In contrast, the value of foreign currency assets increased by $1.3 billion week-on-week to reach $593.2 billion.

Earlier in October, the RBI introduced measures to protect the rupee, including a special arrangement to supply dollars directly from its reserves to three state-run oil-marketing companies. These interventions, along with dollar-rupee sell/buy swaps used to drain excess rupee liquidity from the banking sector, weighed heavily on the reserves after they hit a record high of $785.7 billion in late August.

The record high in August was supported by policy measures that drew $143.5 billion in capital inflows between June 8 and September 18, with approximately $133 billion entering through foreign-currency deposits. The current reserve figures also include Special Drawing Rights and the Reserve Tranche position in the International Monetary Fund.

stories.title: Master Nonwoven Expands Technical Textile Production in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Pakistan's manufacturing sector relies heavily on a complex network of local raw materials, components, and suppliers. For industries such as automotive, hygiene, agriculture, and bedding, having access to locally produced technical materials is crucial for sourcing, production planning, and overall supply chain management.

Nonwoven fabric is a versatile material widely used across these industrial sectors. To meet this demand, the Master Group of Industries entered nonwoven manufacturing in 2002 when organized local capacity was limited. This marked an expansion from the group's origins in foam production into specialized business-to-business material manufacturing.

Today, Master Nonwoven operates with an annual production capacity of 24,000 metric tonnes utilizing Italian-engineered production lines. The company supplies multiple industries, providing nonwovens for diapers and personal-care products, interior and functional automotive parts, crop protection in agriculture, and bedding and packaging solutions, including oxo-biodegradable options.

To ensure quality for industrial buyers, Master Nonwoven offers a wide range of colors and grams per square metre options, along with an in-house laboratory for quality control and end-to-end tracking. The company also holds OEKO-TEX, ISO, and CE certifications, helping manufacturers maintain consistency and reduce dependence on distant supply chains.

stories.title: Iran Reports Three Oil Tanker Fires in the Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy stated on Friday that three oil tankers caught fire and exploded while attempting to use unauthorized routes through the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian state media reported the incident, though Reuters was unable to immediately verify the claims.

According to an official IRGC Navy statement, one of the affected tankers was carrying two million barrels of crude oil when it struck a mine. The exact circumstances surrounding the other two vessels catching fire were linked by authorities to the disputed transit routes through the vital waterway.

In addition to the tanker incidents, Iran claimed it destroyed an unmanned United States vessel in the eastern section of the Strait of Hormuz. The reported actions and escalation of regional tensions come amid heightened scrutiny over maritime traffic in the area.

There was no immediate confirmation from the United States military regarding the drone destruction claim. Independent verification of the tanker explosions and the drone incident remained unavailable as international monitors reviewed the developing situation.

stories.title: یمن میں جاری کشیدگی اور حوثی حملوں پر سعودی اپوزیشن کی محمد بن سلمان پر شدید تنقید
stories.summary:
یمن میں جاری تنازعے اور حوثی گروپ کی طرف سے سعودی عرب کے بنیادی ڈھانچے اور توانائی کی تنصیبات پر ہونے والے حملوں نے مملکت کی سلامتی کو شدید خطرات سے دوچار کر دیا ہے۔ ان حملوں نے ولی عہد محمد بن سلمان کے اہم معاشی منصوبے ویژن 2030 کو بھی چیلنجز کا سامنا کرا دیا ہے، جس کا بنیادی مقصد معیشت کو تیل کے انحصار سے آزاد کرانا ہے۔

سعودی عرب میں سیاسی جماعتوں پر مکمل پابندی ہونے کے باعث بیشتر اپوزیشن جلاوطنی میں سرگرم ہے۔ اس اپوزیشن میں نیشنل اسمبلی پارٹی (ناس) سمیت مختلف سیاسی کارکن اور ذرائع ابلاغ شامل ہیں۔ حوثی حملوں میں اضافے کے بعد جلاوطن ناقدین نے قیادت کی پالیسیوں کو ہدف تنقید بناتے ہوئے ملک کو غیر محفوظ قرار دیا ہے اور فوری طور پر اس جنگ کے خاتمے کا مطالبہ کیا ہے۔

انسانی حقوق کے کارکن یحییٰ عسیری اور دیگر رہنماؤں کا کہنا ہے کہ اس جنگ کی اصل قیمت عام اور غریب عوام ادا کر رہے ہیں۔ ناقدین کا یہ بھی مؤقف ہے کہ مملکت نے تفریحی میلوں اور اربوں ڈالر کے ترقیاتی منصوبوں پر بے دریغ خرچ کیا لیکن قومی سلامتی کو نظر انداز کیا، جس کی وجہ سے دفاعی کمزوریاں کھل کر سامنے آ گئی ہیں۔

کچھ اپوزیشن شخصیات کا خیال ہے کہ اس صورتحال کا فائدہ اٹھاتے ہوئے سعودی عرب نے مبینہ طور پر اسرائیل سے مدد حاصل کی ہے، جو خطے کے وسیع تر مفادات کے برعکس ہے۔ ناقدین نے امریکہ کی محدود حمایت اور ترکی و پاکستان کے ساتھ طے پانے والے دفاعی معاہدے کو بھی ناکافی قرار دیا ہے۔

stories.title: Spanish Transport Minister Refuses Resignation Following Deadly Train Crash
stories.summary:
Spain's Transport Minister Oscar Puente rejected calls for his resignation on Friday following a major train collision near the town of Urda in central Spain. The accident left at least 69 people dead, making it Spain's deadliest train crash since 2013, and followed a January accident on the same line that killed 46 people.

Lawmakers from various political parties condemned Puente for blaming the crash on operator protocol violations rather than accepting responsibility, while rail unions demanded his immediate dismissal. The collision occurred when a moving train operated by Renfe smashed into a stationary Iryo-operated train at speeds between 160 and 200 kilometers per hour. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez vowed to investigate the cause as the country prepares for an upcoming election on November 29.

Preliminary reports from the Independent Authority for the Technical Investigation of Accidents and Incidents indicated that a sequence of malfunctions, instructions, and missing safety barriers led to the crash. Audio recordings revealed that a Madrid control center authorized the Renfe train carrying 379 passengers and seven crew to proceed at normal speed, ignoring protocols to travel slowly or prioritize the stationary train ahead.

Authorities faced difficulties identifying victims because many bodies were severely fragmented, with the Civil Guard listing 64 people as missing. Meanwhile, union representatives argued that the public focus should center on the failure of the outdated LZB signaling system rather than solely attributing the disaster to human error. Documents show that upgrading the line to the standardized European ERTMS system had fallen behind schedule.

stories.title: پی ٹی آئی پارلیمانی پارٹی کا گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کے خاتمے کیلئے مذاکرات کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریک انصاف کی صوبائی پارلیمانی پارٹی نے پشاور میں منعقدہ ایک اجلاس کے دوران گورنر راج، ایمرجنسی اور دیگر معاملات کے حل کے لیے وفاقی حکومت کے ساتھ مذاکرات کی مکمل حمایت کا اعلان کیا ہے۔ سابق وزیراعلیٰ علی امین گنڈاپور سمیت 40 سے زائد ارکان اسمبلی نے اس اجلاس میں شرکت کی۔

اجلاس کے دوران شرکا کا مؤقف تھا کہ وفاقی حکومت کے ساتھ بات چیت کے ذریعے گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کے نفاذ کو واپس لیا جائے تاکہ پارٹی کا مینڈیٹ بحال ہو سکے۔ ارکان نے تجویز دی کہ علی امین گنڈاپور کو وفاقی حکومت کے ساتھ مذاکراتی عمل کا حصہ بنایا جائے تاکہ باہمی مشاورت سے معاملات کو آگے بڑھایا جا سکے۔

پارٹی رہنماؤں کا کہنا تھا کہ گورنر راج کے نفاذ کے بعد کارکنوں کا احتجاج کے لیے باہر نہ نکلنا ایک اچھا فیصلہ تھا کیونکہ اس سے کسی بھی بڑے تصادم سے بچاؤ ممکن ہوا۔ رہنما شوکت یوسفزئی نے بھی اس عمل کی تائید کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ وفاقی حکومت کو چاہیے کہ وہ تلخیاں کم کرے اور صوبے میں گورنر راج اور ایمرجنسی کا خاتمہ کرے۔

اجلاس میں شریک رہنماؤں نے اس عزم کا بھی اظہار کیا کہ پارٹی کا اداروں کے خلاف کسی بھی قسم کے منفی بیانات سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے۔ اجلاس میں بیرسٹر گوہر اور نورالحق قادری سمیت دیگر اہم شخصیات بھی شریک تھیں۔

stories.title: سنگاپور کے وزیر خارجہ کی جی ایچ کیو آمد، فیلڈ مارشل سے ملاقات
stories.summary:
سنگاپور کے وزیر خارجہ ڈاکٹر ویوین بالاکرشنن نے جی ایچ کیو میں فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر سے ملاقات کی ہے۔ اس ملاقات کے دوران باہمی دلچسپی کے امور، دوطرفہ تعاون بڑھانے کے امکانات اور علاقائی و عالمی سیکیورٹی صورتحال پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔ ملاقات میں پاکستان اور سنگاپور کے درمیان دوطرفہ تعلقات کے فروغ اور ادارہ جاتی روابط کو مزید مضبوط بنانے پر خصوصی زور دیا گیا۔

اس موقع پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر نے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ پاکستان خطے میں امن، استحکام اور سلامتی کے فروغ کے لیے مکمل طور پر پُرعزم ہے۔ دوسری جانب سنگاپور کے وزیر خارجہ ڈاکٹر ویوین بالاکرشنن نے پاک فوج کی پیشہ ورانہ صلاحیتوں کی تعریف کی اور علاقائی امن کے قیام کے لیے پاکستان کی گراں قدر خدمات کا کھل کر اعتراف کیا۔

اس دورے اور اعلیٰ سطحی رابطوں کا بنیادی مقصد دونوں ممالک کے مابین تعلقات کو مزید مستحکم کرنا ہے۔ اس ملاقات میں دونوں دوست ممالک کے درمیان دوطرفہ تعلقات کو نئی بلندیاں عطا کرنے کے عزم کا اعادہ کیا گیا، جو خطے کے امن اور خوشحالی کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

stories.title: گزشتہ 13 برس میں خیبر پختونخوا میں صحت اور تعلیم کو نظر انداز کیا گیا: امیر مقام
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر امیر مقام نے پشاور میں ایک تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے خیبر پختونخوا کی سابقہ کارکردگی پر شدید تنقید کی اور کہا کہ پچھلے 13 برسوں کے دوران صوبے میں صحت اور تعلیم کے شعبوں کو عملی طور پر مکمل طور پر نظر انداز کیا گیا ہے۔

انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ اس طویل عرصے کے دوران سوشل میڈیا کے ذریعے عوام کو صرف گمراہ کیا گیا جبکہ امن کے قیام کے حوالے سے تحریک انصاف کا کردار انتہائی مایوس کن رہا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ پی ٹی آئی اس مدت میں یا تو لانگ مارچ کرتی رہی یا پھر دھرنوں کی سیاست میں مصروف رہی۔

امیر مقام نے یہ بھی کہا کہ 11 اکتوبر کا فیصلہ مجبوری کے تحت کیا گیا تھا جبکہ 12 اکتوبر کو عوام نے اس پر جشن منایا۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ اب عوام بخوبی جان چکے ہیں کہ صرف مسلم لیگ (ن) کی قیادت ہی اس صوبے میں حقیقی حالات بدلنے کی صلاحیت رکھتی ہے۔

تقریب کے دوران وفاقی وزیر نے مسلم لیگ ن میں شمولیت اختیار کرنے والے نئے افراد کو خوش آمدید کہا اور اس بات پر زور دیا کہ ن لیگ کی قیادت نے ہمیشہ اقلیتی برادری کو بھرپور عزت دی ہے۔

stories.title: Four Family Members Murdered in Skardu Residential Area
stories.summary:
Four members of a single family, including a husband, his wife, and their two young children, were brutally murdered in a residential area near Madina Colony in Skardu. The victims were identified by police as Ghulam Abbas, his wife Hania Zahra, and their two children, four-year-old Mehdi and two-year-old Dia Zahra. Authorities stated that the victims were attacked with knives. The incident occurred at night, but police were notified during the following day, after which the house was sealed and the bodies were transferred to a hospital.

According to police details, Ghulam Abbas originally hailed from Talor in Rondu, Baltistan, while Hania Zahra was from Parachinar. The violent crime prompted a high-level response from regional leadership. The Chief Minister of Gilgit-Baltistan formally took notice of the situation and instructed the Inspector General of Police to submit a comprehensive report.

Deputy Inspector General of Baltistan Asif Mumtaz described the killings as intolerable. He assured the public that all available resources would be deployed to track down the perpetrators, ensure their arrest, and deliver justice to the victims.

In an unrelated recent development, police in Punjab reported an encounter in Muridke tehsil, Sheikhupura district, where two suspects allegedly involved in the rape and murder of a five-year-old boy named Aun Abbas were killed by Crime Control Department officers. Those suspects were identified as neighbors of the young victim.

stories.title: Chinese Electric Vehicles Make Inroads in South Korea and Japan
stories.summary:
Chinese automakers like BYD are expanding their footprint in South Korea and Japan, challenging long-established domestic car industries. In July, 48-year-old Seoul resident Kim Min-seon purchased an inexpensive, well-equipped BYD Dolphin compact EV for roughly $18,500 after facing a two-year delivery wait for a local alternative. While Chinese vehicles were previously dismissed as shoddy, South Korea's high EV adoption rate—accounting for about a quarter of new car sales—has helped Chinese brands gain momentum.

In the first nine months of the year, BYD sold more than 20,000 vehicles in South Korea, surpassing the combined sales of Toyota and its Lexus brand. Analysts note that South Korean consumers have a growing appetite for affordable electric cars, whereas domestic giants like Hyundai and Kia primarily focus on premium models priced above $30,000. This surge has caused concern among local industry figures, prompting calls from Korea Automobile & Mobility Association chairman Jeong Dae-jin for tax incentives favoring domestically produced electric vehicles.

Conversely, sales and market penetration in Japan have been much slower, with foreign brands capturing only about six percent of passenger car sales and local drivers favoring hybrids. Although BYD entered the Japanese market in 2023 and has built over 75 dealerships with plans to reach 100, it sold fewer than 4,000 cars in the first nine months of the year, accounting for a modest 0.1 percent market share. Despite this, industry observers emphasize the importance of ongoing growth rather than immediate market dominance.

Diplomatic tensions and unfavorable public views regarding China in both countries have presented additional hurdles, alongside skepticism from some consumers and politicians regarding vehicle reliability and security risks. Nevertheless, companies such as Chery-backed startup EMT and Zeekr are proceeding with future regional launches, signaling that Chinese manufacturers remain committed to expanding across East Asian markets.

stories.title: Geo News and UN Women Pakistan Partner to Advance Gender Equality
stories.summary:
UN Women Pakistan and Geo News have established a partnership through the UN Women Global Media Compact to promote gender equality and women's empowerment. The initiative encourages media organisations to integrate gender perspectives into editorial practices, challenge harmful stereotypes, and amplify women's voices in leadership.

Fahmida Iqbal Khan, Deputy Country Representative of UN Women in Pakistan, emphasized that media representation shapes societal views, noting that women are frequently portrayed as victims rather than professionals. Azhar Abbas, managing director of Geo News, stated that responsible journalism requires fair representation and committed the network to enhancing gender-responsive editorial practices and featuring a wider range of women experts.

The collaboration aims to raise awareness regarding critical social issues, including gender-based violence, economic empowerment, political participation, and digital safety. It also stresses ethical reporting on sensitive matters to protect survivors' dignity and privacy without reinforcing social stigmas.

The announcement coincides with broader private-sector engagement under the Women's Empowerment Principles (WEPs), which features over 190 participating companies in Pakistan. Furthermore, the Pakistan WEPs Awards 2026, organized by UN Women Pakistan with Geo as a media partner, recognize local businesses creating inclusive workplaces and advancing gender equality across the region.

stories.title: قطری وفد کی تہران آمد، آبنائے ہرمز میں آئل ٹینکر حادثہ اور ہیلی کاپٹر لاپتا
stories.summary:
ایرانی خبر رساں ایجنسی ارنا کے مطابق جمعہ تیس اکتوبر کی صبح قطری وزیراعظم اور وزیرِ خارجہ کے سینئر مشیر کی قیادت میں ایک وفد تہران پہنچا ہے جہاں دوطرفہ تعلقات اور خطے کی صورتحال پر مشاورت کی جا رہی ہے۔ ذرائع کے مطابق یہ دورہ ایران اور امریکہ کے درمیان ممکنہ رابطوں اور معاہدے کی کوششوں کا حصہ ہے۔ دوسری جانب پاسداران انقلاب نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ آبنائے ہرمز میں دو آئل ٹینکر اپنے نیویگیشن سسٹم بند کر کے اور امریکی فوج کی حمایت سے غیر مجاز راستے سے گزرنے کے دوران حادثے کا شکار ہو گئے۔ برطانوی میری ٹائم ٹریڈ آپریشنز سینٹر کے مطابق عمان کے شہر خصب کے قریب ایک اور آئل ٹینکر کے بائیں جانب دھماکا خیز مواد نصب کیا گیا جس سے انجن روم میں آگ لگی لیکن عملہ محفوظ رہا۔

بھارتی ریاست اتراکھنڈ کے ضلع چمولی میں بدری ناتھ سے دہرادون جانے والا ٹرانس بھارت ایوی ایشن کا ایک ہیلی کاپٹر جوشی مٹھ وادی کے اوپر پرواز کے دوران لاپتا ہو گیا۔ پائلٹ سمیت چھ افراد پر مشتمل اس ہیلی کاپٹر کی تلاش کے لیے ضلعی انتظامیہ، ڈیزاسٹر مینجمنٹ اور ایس ڈی آر ایف کی ٹیمیں امدادی کارروائیوں میں مصروف ہیں۔ وزیرِ اعلیٰ پشکر سنگھ دھامی خود اس صورتحال کی نگرانی کر رہے ہیں جبکہ یوکاڈا کے مطابق پرواز کا رابطہ منقطع ہونے کی وجہ سے درست مقام اور حادثے کی نوعیت ابھی واضح نہیں ہو سکی ہے۔ آبنائے ہرمز کے واقعات کے باعث عالمی منڈی میں برینٹ کروڈ آئل کی قیمت ایک ڈالر بیس سینٹ اضافے کے ساتھ 116 ڈالر ہو گئی ہے۔

امریکی ریاست جارجیا کے شہر اٹلانٹا میں جی ٹو کے وزرائے خارجہ کا اجلاس امریکی وزیر خارجہ مارکو روبیو کی میزبانی میں ہونے جا رہا ہے جس میں روس کے سرگئی لاوروف سمیت دیگر ممالک کے حکام شریک ہوں گے۔ اس اجلاس میں یوکرین اور ایران کی جنگوں اور توانائی کی قیمتوں میں اضافے پر شدید اختلافات کی توقع ہے۔ دریں اثنا سعودی عرب کی قیادت میں قائم فوجی اتحاد نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ حوثی ملیشیا کی جانب سے مکہ کے فضائی علاقے میں بھیجا جانے والا ایک ڈرون روکا اور تباہ کر دیا گیا ہے۔ ان تمام پیش رفتوں نے خطے میں کشیدگی کو مزید بڑھا دیا ہے اور عالمی سطح پر سفارتی کوششیں جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Pakistan Army Destroys Afghan Taliban Posts After Deadly Angoor Adda Firing
stories.summary:
Pakistan's armed forces destroyed multiple Afghan Taliban posts and military positions adjacent to South Waziristan and Parachinar using heavy weaponry. State-run Radio Pakistan reported that the army responded to unprovoked firing along the border in the Angoor Adda area, forcing Afghan Taliban personnel to abandon their posts with several reported casualties.

The military action followed an attack on Tuesday where Afghan security forces opened fire on Pakistani border posts and residential areas, killing one local civilian and injuring a family of five. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi condemned the attack, stating that violations of Pakistani sovereignty would never be tolerated.

Pakistan rejected subsequent claims from the Afghan defence ministry labeling Islamabad as the aggressor. The Angoor Adda crossing serves as a vital trade and public transit route, while Islamabad continues to press Kabul to dismantle terrorist sanctuaries used by groups like the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan.

Border skirmishes have recurred in recent months, including September airstrikes and drone interceptions during Operation Ghazab lil-Haq. Although Pakistan remains open to sincere international efforts to resolve the dispute, officials maintain that talks with Afghanistan cannot be unconditional.

stories.title: KSE-100 Index Drops Over 700 Points to Close Lower at PSX
stories.summary:
Trading at the Pakistan Stock Exchange concluded in negative territory on Friday, October 30, 2026. Data published by the exchange showed the benchmark KSE-100 index dropping by 784.19 points, marking a 0.47 percent decline to finish the session at 166,409.25 points. In the previous trading session, the index had closed higher at 167,193.44 points.

During the day's operations, the market fluctuated between an intraday high of 167,338.73 and a low of 166,326.70 points. Activity in the regular market picked up slightly, with trading volume rising to 825,467,439 shares compared to 816,834,095 shares previously.

Despite the higher share volume, overall financial metrics experienced a downturn. The total traded value decreased to Rs. 23,122,732,916 from the previous figure of Rs. 31,541,890,680, while market capitalization contracted to Rs. 18,388,885,711,574 down from Rs. 18,492,644,189,180.

In the Ready Market, out of 501 total companies, 173 registered gains, 300 experienced losses, and 28 remained unchanged. The session's numbers reflect widespread selling pressure across numerous listed equities on the exchange.

stories.title: PSL Franchises Permitted Seven Retentions Under New Rules for Season 12
stories.summary:
Pakistan Super League franchises will be allowed to retain up to seven players, including any direct signing, for the upcoming 12th edition of the tournament. However, any franchise utilizing the maximum retention limit must release a player from the highest price tier of the previous auction back into the general player pool. This regulation was unanimously approved by all eight franchises during a tournament operations workshop at Gaddafi Stadium ahead of the player auction scheduled for January 23.

The mandatory release aims to ensure elite talent remains accessible to all teams while allowing clubs to preserve core portions of their squads. The retention deadline is set for January 13, enabling franchises to evaluate player performances from the concluded National T20 Silver tournament and the ongoing National T20 Gold competition. The Pakistan Cricket Board noted this timeline establishes a data-driven link between domestic cricket and the PSL, giving in-form domestic players a real-time opportunity to attract franchise interest.

The tournament will operate under a salary cap of Rs45 crore per franchise, which increases to Rs50.5 crore for teams that make a direct signing, retain a previous direct signing, or both. Additionally, all franchises must spend a minimum of Rs36.5 crore on their squads. The direct signing window remains open until November 23, 2026, allowing each team to sign one marquee player who did not participate in PSL 10 or PSL 11.

The regulations were finalized under the leadership of PSL chief executive Salman Naseer, who praised the open engagement and unanimous agreement reached by all eight franchises. Naseer emphasized that aligning the retention deadline with ongoing domestic tournaments provides a genuine pathway for local performers to influence squad selections, with further major announcements expected from the Pakistan Cricket Board in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Federal Constitutional Court Warns Against Ignoring Supreme Court Decisions
stories.summary:
The Federal Constitutional Court expressed strong disapproval regarding the failure to implement a previous Supreme Court judgment concerning sacked government employees. During a hearing on contempt petitions against the federal and Punjab governments, the court emphasized that delaying or disregarding judicial rulings challenges the foundational framework of the legal system and threatens democratic governance.

The case stems from a December 17, 2021 Supreme Court verdict that reviewed the validity of the Sacked Employees (Reinstatement) Ordinance Act 2010. That ruling voided the legislation, which had previously provided jobs or promotions to approximately 17,000 workers, while converting review hearings to safeguard fundamental livelihood rights. In a ten-page order, Justice Ali Baqar Najafi stressed that Supreme Court directives are binding legal mandates rather than mere recommendations, and compliance is a constitutional requirement necessary to maintain public confidence.

Addressing the specifics of the case, the court noted that the original 2021 judgment required beneficiary employees to pass Federal Public Service Commission tests within three months. Because employers failed to conduct these aptitude and skill evaluations, the court ruled that the delay was due to employer inaction and lethargy rather than any fault of the employees. Consequently, the court held that the testing conditions were waived over time and workers could not be disadvantaged by the administration's failure to act.

The bench, headed by Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan and including Justice Ali Baqar Najafi, underscored that the employees were repeatedly tossed between hiring, firing, and reinstatement by successive governments without any personal wrongdoing. The court cautioned that executive non-compliance with apex court decisions undermines institutional equilibrium, erodes public trust in governance, and sets a dangerous precedent of executive overreach.

stories.title: PML-N Leader Ikhtiar Wali Criticizes PTI Over Unfulfilled Promises in KP
stories.summary:
Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz leader Ikhtiar Wali Khan publicly criticized the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf for failing to deliver tangible progress in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa throughout thirteen years in power. Speaking at a local joining ceremony, the PML-N leader questioned the realization of promised welfare initiatives and pointed to recurring corruption exposures as evidence of hypocrisy among political opponents.

Wali challenged the audience to locate examples of the promised five million houses and ten million jobs, asserting that even the architectural designs for the housing scheme were never seen. He also questioned claims regarding the establishment of a state modeled on the principles of Madina, asking whether anyone had witnessed even a fraction of such governance during the party's tenure in the province.

Accusing PTI figures of personal enrichment under the banner of political change, Wali claimed that individuals associated with the party experienced dramatic financial transformations within a decade. He alleged that ordinary individuals, such as a small-scale butcher and local shop owners in Swat, had amassed massive fortunes, acquiring palaces, large hotels, and assets worth tens of billions of rupees.

Concluding his remarks, the PML-N leader questioned whether the dramatic accumulation of wealth by political loyalists aligns with the revolution and reform promised to the public. Wali's address emphasized his party's ongoing critique of the provincial administration's economic record and governance over the past decade.

stories.title: PTI Lawmakers Confront Mahmood Khan Achakzai Over Steering Committee Delay
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf lawmakers recently confronted National Assembly Opposition Leader Mahmood Khan Achakzai in Lahore, demanding the prompt execution of resolutions finalized during parliamentary party gatherings. Party members presented documentation from a previous meeting, urging the creation of a steering committee without further postponement. In response, Achakzai questioned the urgency of the matter, arguing that the party could afford to wait several months before acting.

This reaction sparked intense frustration among PTI members, who highlighted the critical circumstances surrounding the imprisonment of party founder Imran Khan, alongside his wife and sisters. Lawmakers emphasized that ignoring these hardships in favor of a delayed timeline was unacceptable. They insisted that if dialogue with the administration is to proceed, the official notification for the steering committee must be released immediately.

Furthermore, participants suggested that if Achakzai holds reservations about communicating with National Assembly Speaker Ayaz Sadiq, negotiations could instead be spearheaded by Senate Opposition Leader Senator Allama Raja Nasir Abbas. Legislators also reproached Achakzai for previously missing a parliamentary session to visit Quetta, asserting that the primary objective must remain securing access to and the release of their incarcerated leadership.

This friction follows a marathon seven-hour joint parliamentary party meeting held on Tuesday, which featured heated debates regarding internal disagreements, planned demonstrations, and government talks. Critics during that session contrasted Achakzai's current approach with his past handling of his son's arrest in Kharian. Meanwhile, financial data indicated that the Pakistan Stock Exchange concluded lower on October 30, 2026, with the KSE-100 index dropping 784.19 points to finish at 166,409.25.

stories.title: UAE Equity Markets Slide Amid Soft Corporate Earnings and Regional Unrest
stories.summary:
Stock markets across the United Arab Emirates finished lower on Friday, pressured by disappointing corporate financial reports and escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Regional stability was rattled as Yemeni Houthis targeted Saudi Arabian airports and oil infrastructure, while multiple oil tankers sustained damage in the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, discussions occurred in Washington where a top US military commander briefed President Donald Trump on potential military strategies regarding Iran.

In Dubai, the primary index fell by 0.8 percent, marking a third consecutive session of losses driven primarily by real estate and financial equities. Major institutions experienced declines, including a 1.1 percent drop for Emirates NBD Bank and a 0.9 percent decrease for developer Emaar Properties. Furthermore, exchange operator Dubai Financial Market slid 1.6 percent after announcing quarterly drops in both net profit and total income.

Abu Dhabi’s benchmark index experienced a slight downward movement of 0.1 percent, influenced by a 3.9 percent reduction in Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank and a 1.3 percent decline for ADNOC Distribution. Two Point Zero Group, an affiliate of IHC, also saw its shares drop 2.5 percent following a 25 percent reduction in third-quarter net profit down to 1.51 billion dirhams, equivalent to $411.15 million.

Conversely, crude prices advanced as market participants prepared for potential geopolitical escalation following US midterm elections, with Brent crude rising 2.3 percent to $117.56 per barrel. Over the course of the week, Abu Dhabi registered a 1.3 percent loss, whereas Dubai managed a 0.6 percent weekly gain.

stories.title: امریکی ریاست اوہائیو میں دوران پرواز پائلٹس کا پراسرار فضائی شے کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
امریکی ریاست اوہائیو کے قریب پرواز کرنے والے طیارے کے پائلٹس نے فضا میں ایک پراسرار اور چمکدار کیپسول نما شے دیکھنے کا دعویٰ کیا ہے۔ نیشنل یو ایف او رپورٹنگ سینٹر پر شیئر کی گئی تفصیلات کے مطابق یہ واقعہ 16 اگست کو پیش آیا تھا، جب فضائی عملے نے ایک عجیب و غریب شے کو بظاہر ساکن حالت میں دیکھا۔ طیارے کے قریب آنے پر پائلٹس نے ایئر ٹریفک کنٹرول سے رابطہ کیا، لیکن کلیولینڈ سینٹر کے کنٹرولرز اور ریڈار نے کسی بھی نامعلوم شے کی موجودگی سے لاعلمی ظاہر کی۔

تحقیقاتی رپورٹ کے مطابق پائلٹ نے اس پراسرار جسم کی تصویر بھی بنائی جو بعد میں تفتیش کار بین ہینسن کو دی گئی۔ پائلٹ نے اپنی شناخت ظاہر نہ کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ اس شے کی سطح چاندی کی طرح انتہائی ہموار اور چمکدار تھی جس پر کوئی جوڑ یا نچلا حصہ نظر نہیں آ رہا تھا۔ پائلٹ کا خیال تھا کہ یہ شے ان گرج چمک والے بادلوں سے نکلی تھی جن کے درمیان سے گزرنے کی کوشش طیارے کا عملہ کر رہا تھا، کیونکہ اس دوران انجن پر برف جمنے اور درمیانی درجے کے جھٹکوں کا سامنا بھی ہوا۔

اس واقعے کے حوالے سے فلائٹ ٹریکنگ ایپ یا تصادم سے بچاؤ کے نظام پر بھی کوئی اشارہ ظاہر نہیں ہوا۔ ماہرین یا حکام کی طرف سے اس کی آزادانہ تصدیق نہیں ہو سکی کہ یہ کوئی خلائی مخلوق تھی یا کوئی غیر معمولی ٹیکنالوجی، اور اس کی اصل شناخت تاحال نامعلوم ہے۔ اس معاملے کی اہمیت اس لیے ہے کہ یہ ہوا بازوں کی سلامتی اور غیر یقینی فضائی مشاہدات سے جڑا ہوا ایک منفرد واقعہ ہے۔

نیشنل یو ایف او رپورٹنگ سینٹر پر 26 اکتوبر کو اس واقعے کی باضابطہ تفصیلات عوام کے سامنے لائی گئیں۔ اس تمام صورتحال کے باوجود، اس پراسرار فضائی شے کے بارے میں کوئی حتمی رائے قائم نہیں کی جا سکی اور یہ معمہ تاحال برقرار ہے۔

stories.title: Sri Lankan Equities Close Lower Driven by Declines in Financial Stocks
stories.summary:
Sri Lankan equity markets finished the trading week in negative territory on Friday, pulled down predominantly by losses within the financial sector. The CSE All-Share index decreased by 0.6 percent to settle at 20,142.33 points at the conclusion of the session. Key downward pressures on the benchmark index included Hatton National Bank PLC and LOLC Holdings PLC, which recorded share price drops of 1.3 percent and 3.7 percent respectively.

Market activity saw a notable contraction compared to the preceding session. Trading volume dropped significantly to 48.6 million shares, a sharp decline from the 117.4 million shares recorded previously. Total market turnover also experienced a steep reduction, falling to 958.6 million Sri Lankan rupees, or approximately $2.88 million, down from 2.27 billion rupees in the prior session.

Foreign participants acted as net sellers during the trading day, offloading equities valued at 102 million rupees. Meanwhile, domestic participants stepped in as net buyers, acquiring shares with a total value of 928.8 million rupees. These figures highlight a cautious approach among international investors amid the broader market downturn.

stories.title: لاہور ہائیکورٹ کا سرکاری اسپتالوں میں چار ہفتوں کے اندر پرچی سسٹم ختم کرنے کا حکم
stories.summary:
لاہور ہائیکورٹ نے سرکاری اسپتالوں میں مریضوں کو درپیش مشکلات اور بنیادی سہولیات کے فقدان سے متعلق دائر درخواست پر اپنا اہم فیصلہ جاری کر دیا ہے۔ عدالت عالیہ کے جسٹس ملک جاوید اقبال وینس نے اس کیس کی سماعت کی اور طبی نظام میں بہتری کے لیے سخت احکامات صادر کیے ہیں۔

عدالت نے اپنے حکم میں ہدایت کی ہے کہ سرکاری اسپتالوں میں جاری پرچی سسٹم کو آئندہ چار ہفتوں کے اندر مکمل طور پر ختم کیا جائے۔ عدالت کا کہنا ہے کہ علاج معالجے سے قبل رجسٹریشن کاؤنٹرز سے پرچی حاصل کرنے کی پابندی سے مریضوں کو فوری طور پر آزاد کیا جائے۔

عدالت عالیہ نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ ایمرجنسی اور آؤٹ ڈور میں آنے والے تمام مریضوں کو لمبی قطاروں میں کھوار ہونے کی زحمت دیے بغیر فوری طبی امداد کی فراہمی یقینی بنائی جائے۔ اسپیشل سیکریٹری صحت نے عدالت کو یقین دلایا کہ جدید نظام کے ذریعے اس تمام عمل کو مزید آسان اور مؤثر بنایا جائے گا۔

عدالت نے متعلقہ حکام سے سرکاری اسپتالوں میں طبی سہولیات کی فراہمی سے متعلق جامع رپورٹ بھی طلب کر لی ہے۔ لاہور ہائیکورٹ نے خبردار کیا ہے کہ اگر مقررہ چار ہفتوں میں عدالتی احکامات پر عمل درآمد نہ کیا گیا تو ذمہ دار افسران کے خلاف قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی، اور اس کیس کی مزید سماعت چھ ہفتوں کے لیے ملتوی کر دی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: عراق جانے والے پاکستانی زائرین کے لیے ایران کے راستے سفر کے حوالے سے نئی ہدایات جاری
stories.summary:
حکومتِ پاکستان نے ایران سے زمینی راستے کے ذریعے عراق جانے کے منتظر تمام زائرین کو ہدایت کی ہے کہ وہ سفر کرنے سے قبل نئی سفری ہدایات کا ضرور جائزہ لیں۔ وزارتِ مذہبی امور کے ترجمان کے مطابق یہ اقدام ایران اور عراق کے درمیان واقع الشیب بارڈر کی اچانک بندش کے بعد اٹھایا گیا ہے۔

ترجمان نے وضاحت کی کہ 21 اکتوبر سے الشیب بارڈر کو مسافروں، گاڑیوں اور تجارتی سامان کی آمدورفت کے لیے تاحکم ثانی بند کر دیا گیا ہے، جس کی وجہ سے اس زمینی راستے سے آمدورفت مکمل طور پر معطل ہے۔ اس بندش کے باعث پاکستانی زائرین کے لیے کوئی متبادل زمینی راستہ فی الحال دستیاب نہیں ہے۔

وزارتِ مذہبی امور نے ایران میں اس وقت موجود زائرین کو مشورہ دیا ہے کہ وہ عراق جانے کے لیے بغداد اور نجف کے بین الاقوامی ہوائی اڈوں کا استعمال کریں۔ اس کے علاوہ تمام زیارت گروپ آرگنائزرز کو بھی ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ وہ بارڈر کی بندش کی صورتحال سے زائرین کو فوری طور پر مطلع کریں۔

حکومت نے مسافروں پر زور دیا ہے کہ وہ کسی بھی دشواری سے بچنے کے لیے ان نئی ہدایات پر سختی سے عمل کریں، کیونکہ زمینی گزرگاہ بند ہونے کی وجہ سے عراقی سفر کے لیے صرف فضائی راستے ہی اب قابلِ استعمال رہ گئے ہیں۔

stories.title: کراچی میں ترقیاتی کام مربوط منصوبہ بندی سے آگے بڑھیں گے، شرجیل میمن کا اعلان
stories.summary:
سندھ کے سینئر وزیر شرجیل میمن نے کہا ہے کہ معاشی حب کراچی کو جدید خطوط پر استوار کرنے کے لیے تمام ترقیاتی کام مکمل مربوط منصوبہ بندی کے تحت آگے بڑھائے جائیں گے۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ شہر میں جدید پبلک ٹرانسپورٹ کے نظام کو وسعت دینے کے لیے اقدامات تیزی سے جاری ہیں۔

اپنے بیان میں شرجیل میمن نے وضاحت کی کہ پورٹ قاسم سے موٹر وے تک لنک روڈ اور قیوم آباد کے مجوزہ ایلیویٹڈ ایکسپریس وے جیسے اہم منصوبوں پر کام انتہائی تیزی سے جاری ہے، جن کا مقصد شہر کی مرکزی شاہراہوں کے درمیان باہمی رابطوں کو بہتر بنانا ہے۔

انہوں نے مزید خوشخبری سناتے ہوئے کہا کہ شہریوں کی سفری سہولیات کے لیے ڈبل ڈیکر بسیں اور مزید نئی الیکٹرک وہیکل (ای وی) بسیں اگلے ماہ ہی کراچی پہنچ رہی ہیں۔ اس کے ساتھ ہی ان نئی بسوں کے لیے نئے روٹس کی منصوبہ بندی کا عمل بھی جاری ہے۔

صوبائی وزیر نے عزم ظاہر کیا کہ یہ تمام اقدامات کراچی کے شہریوں کو بہتر، جدید اور آرام دہ سفری سہولیات فراہم کرنے کے لیے اٹھائے جا رہے ہیں، جس سے شہر کے پبلک ٹرانسپورٹ کے نظام میں نمایاں بہتری آئے گی۔

stories.title: ٹیکنیکل خرابی کی وجہ سے اسلام آباد سے کراچی کی پرواز ڈیڑھ گھنٹہ تاخیر کا شکار
stories.summary:
ایک نجی ایئرلائن کی اسلام آباد سے کراچی جانے والی پرواز فنی مسائل کی بنا پر تاخیر سے روانہ ہوئی۔ اس پرواز کے ذریعے کئی اہم سیاسی شخصیات کو کراچی سفر کرنا تھا، جن میں خاتون اول آصفہ بھٹو زرداری، ڈپٹی اسپیکر سید مصطفیٰ شاہ، وزیر مملکت کھیئل داس کوہستانی اور دیگر اراکین اسمبلی بھی شامل تھے۔

طے شدہ شیڈول کے مطابق اس پرواز کو شام چار بجے کراچی کے لیے روانہ ہونا تھا، لیکن خرابی اور دیگر وجوہات کی وجہ سے طیارہ ڈیڑھ گھنٹے تک مسلسل رن وے پر ہی کھڑا رہا۔ بعد ازاں، ایئرپورٹ ذرائع نے تصدیق کی کہ متعلقہ پرواز مقررہ وقت سے ڈیڑھ گھنٹہ تاخیر کے بعد بالآخر اسلام آباد سے کراچی کے لیے روانہ ہو گئی۔

اس نوعیت کے واقعات سے مسافروں بالخصوص اہم سرکاری اور سیاسی شخصیات کو سفر کے دوران شدید پریشانی کا سامنا کرنا پڑتا ہے۔ متعلقہ ایئرلائن اور حکام کی جانب سے اس قسم کی تکنیکی خرابیوں پر قابو پانے کے لیے اقدامات ناگزیر ہیں تاکہ ہوائی سفر کو محفوظ اور بروقت بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: وفاقی وزیر پیٹرولیم علی پرویز ملک سے سعودی سفیر کی ملاقات، توانائی تعاون پر تبادلہ خیال
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر پیٹرولیم علی پرویز ملک نے پاکستان میں تعینات سعودی عرب کے سفیر سے اہم ملاقات کی ہے۔ اس ملاقات کے دوران دونوں رہنماؤں کے درمیان معدنیات، پیٹرولیم اور توانائی کے شعبوں میں باہمی تعاون کو مزید فروغ دینے کے حوالے سے تفصیلی گفتگو کی گئی۔ ملاقات کا بنیادی مقصد دوطرفہ تعلقات کو مستحکم کرنا تھا۔

ملاقات میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزیر علی پرویز ملک نے بتایا کہ پاکستان نے حال ہی میں ٹیکس نیوٹرل بانڈڈ اسٹوریج پالیسی کی منظوری دی ہے۔ اس نئی پالیسی کے تحت سعودی عرب کی مختلف کمپنیوں کو تجارتی بنیادوں پر تیل کے ذخائر قائم کرنے کی خصوصی پیشکش کی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے حب میں اسٹوریج اور ریفائننگ کمپلیکس منصوبے کی اہمیت پر بھی روشنی ڈالی۔

دوسری جانب سعودی سفیر نے اعلان کیا کہ پاکستانی شہریوں کے لیے ویزا درخواستوں کی اسی روز پراسیسنگ کو یقینی بنایا جائے گا۔ اس سہولت سے دونوں ممالک کے درمیان کاروباری سرگرمیوں، ثقافتی تبادلوں اور عوامی روابط کو مزید فروغ حاصل ہوگا۔

stories.title: راجن پور میں کچے کے انتہائی مطلوب اشتہاری ڈاکو گمن گوپانگ نے ہتھیار ڈال دیے
stories.summary:
صوبہ پنجاب کے ضلع راجن پور میں کچے کے علاقے کے انتہائی مطلوب اور خطرناک اشتہاری ڈاکو گمن عرف گمنی گوپانگ نے قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے سامنے ہتھیار ڈال دیے ہیں۔ اس ڈاکو کی گرفتاری کو پولیس اور قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کی ایک بڑی کامیابی قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

راجن پور پولیس کے مطابق حکومت پنجاب نے ڈاکو گمن کے سر کی قیمت 50 لاکھ روپے مقرر کر رکھی تھی۔ وہ قتل، اغوا برائے تاوان اور ڈکیتی جیسے درجنوں سنگین نوعیت کے مقدمات میں پولیس کو انتہائی مطلوب تھا۔ اس کے سرینڈر کرنے سے علاقے میں امن و امان کی صورتحال بہتر ہونے کی توقع کی جا رہی ہے۔

پولیس حکام نے اس پیشرفت کو کچے کے علاقے میں قانون کی عملداری کے لیے اہم سنگ میل قرار دیا ہے۔ اس کے ہتھیار ڈالنے سے علاقے میں جرائم کی شرح میں کمی آئے گی اور عوام کو بڑی حد تک ریلیف ملے گا۔

stories.title: Iran Reports Stopping Two Tankers and Destroying US Unmanned Vessel
stories.summary:
The naval branch of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced on Friday that two oil tankers were intercepted and brought to a halt in waters situated south of the Strait of Hormuz. According to Iranian authorities, the vessels were involved in unspecified incidents after they disregarded repeated radio warnings and attempted to navigate through the vital waterway using an unauthorized path.

In addition to the tanker incident, Iran stated on Friday that it successfully destroyed an unmanned American vessel located in the eastern portion of the Strait of Hormuz. The military actions underscore heightened friction in the strategically important maritime corridor. As of the announcement, the United States military had not issued any immediate confirmation regarding either of the reported events.

stories.title: FBR Defends Faceless Customs Assessment as Digital Transformation Advances
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue has strongly defended its Faceless Customs Assessment initiative, noting that moving the Central Appraising Unit to Islamabad is a permanent modernization step. The agency emphasized that the change aims to limit discretionary powers and decrease direct contact between officials and taxpayers. While the assessment process shifts to the capital, physical examinations and port operations will remain stationed in Karachi.

Addressing complaints from the All Pakistan Textile Mills Association regarding delays and valuation disputes, the FBR reported that average clearance times have decreased from 40.2 hours to 20.57 hours, with 83% of shipments cleared within two days. The board stressed that customs valuation continues to follow strict legal standards under Section 25 of the Customs Act of 1969, prohibiting arbitrary price increases.

This digital shift aligns with broader FBR technological upgrades, including the Digital Invoicing System and artificial intelligence-based production monitoring designed to eliminate tax evasion and ensure fair competition. The administration noted that global models in countries like Singapore, India, and Dubai successfully utilize similar tech-driven customs frameworks to enhance transparency and efficiency.

To further boost clearance speeds, the FBR plans to implement specialized measures such as dedicated backlog processing, pre-arrival filing of Goods Declarations, and green-channel facilitation for compliant importers. Trade organizations have been urged to submit specific, verifiable cases of delays to help authorities resolve remaining operational hurdles smoothly.

stories.title: سی ڈی اے کا جے یو آئی سے منسلک مدارس اور رہائش گاہ کو نوٹس
stories.summary:
کیپتل ڈیولپمنٹ اتھارٹی (سی ڈی اے) اسلام آباد نے جمعیت علمائے اسلام (جے یو آئی) سے منسلک متعدد مدارس کو بلڈنگ کنٹرول قوانین کی مبینہ خلاف ورزیوں پر نوٹس جاری کر دیے ہیں۔ ان اداروں میں مدرسہ اختر العلوم، ادارہ معارف اسلامیہ، شریعہ ربانیہ اور تفی القرآن شامل ہیں، جن پر غیر قانونی تعمیرات، منظور شدہ بلڈنگ پلان کے بغیر کام اور سیٹ بیکس پر تجاوزات قائم کرنے کے الزامات عائد کیے گئے ہیں۔

مدرسہ اختر العلوم سمیت مختلف مدارس کو 15 روز کے اندر تعمیراتی نقشے جمع کرانے یا خلاف ورزیاں ختم کرنے کی ہدایت کی گئی ہے، بصورت دیگر عمارت سیل کرنے، جرمانے عائد کرنے اور الاٹمنٹ منسوخ کرنے کی تنبیہ کی گئی ہے۔ سی ڈی اے کا یہ بھی اعتراض ہے کہ بعض عمارتوں کو رہائشی استعمال کے بجائے مدارس کے لیے استعمال کیا جا رہا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ جے یو آئی کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمان کی اسلام آباد میں واقع رہائش گاہ کو بھی قواعد کی خلاف ورزیوں اور تجاوزات پر نوٹس دیا گیا ہے۔

اس کارروائی کے ردعمل میں مولانا فضل الرحمان کے صاحبزادے مولانا اسجد محمود نے دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ پشاور میں کور کمانڈر کے سامنے تجاوزات کی نشاندہی کرنے پر یہ انتقامی کارروائیاں شروع کی گئی ہیں۔ انہوں نے الزام لگایا کہ سیاسی اختلافات کو ذاتی انتقام میں بدلا جا رہا ہے اور ملک کے تمام اداروں کو ایک شخص کے انتقامی جذبات کی تسکین کے لیے استعمال کیا جا رہا ہے۔

سی ڈی اے نے واضح کیا ہے کہ اسلام آباد میں بلڈنگ کنٹرول قوانین پر عمل درآمد کے لیے مدارس سمیت تمام عمارتوں کے خلاف بلاامتیاز کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اس اقدام سے سیاسی حلقوں میں ہلچل مچ گئی ہے اور فریقین کی جانب سے بیانات کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔

stories.title: First Patient Receives Groundbreaking Stem-Cell Treatment for Parkinson's Disease
stories.summary:
A patient has received a pioneering stem-cell therapy for Parkinson's disease in what the Japanese drugmaker describes as a world-first procedure following conditional approval in the country. Sumitomo Pharma announced that millions of induced pluripotent stem cells were transplanted into the patient's brain at Kyoto University Hospital in October. Parkinson's is a degenerative neurological disorder impacting motor systems, currently affecting over 10 million people worldwide with treatments that only manage symptoms.

The therapy utilizes iPS cells derived from healthy donors, which are developed into precursors for dopamine-producing brain cells that Parkinson's patients lose. During earlier clinical trials involving seven patients aged 50 to 69, participants received implants of five to ten million cells on both sides of the brain and were monitored for two years without major adverse effects, while four patients demonstrated symptom improvements.

Sumitomo Pharma aims to perform similar transplants on 20 to 30 patients by March 2029. The company is also conducting a separate clinical trial in the United States. Local media reports indicate that full regulatory approval in Japan will depend on confirming the safety and efficacy of the treatment over the next seven years.

This announcement follows closely behind another medical milestone in Japan, where an Osaka hospital conducted the world's first surgery using heart muscle iPS cell sheets to restore cardiac function. Both therapies received conditional regulatory approval in the country in March, highlighting Japan's advancing role in regenerative medicine.

stories.title: Punjab Government Launches Free Guest Relations Officer Course for Women
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has introduced a complimentary three-month Guest Relations Officer training course tailored specifically for women. Launched under the Women Development Department's SEHR Programme, the initiative aims to provide essential practical skills and open employment pathways within the expanding hospitality sector.

Eligible female candidates between the ages of 18 and 45 are invited to apply for the entirely free program. The curriculum will be delivered at the Institute of Tourism and Hospitality Management, operated by the Tourism Development Corporation of Punjab located in Lahore, and will feature hands-on practical training components.

Authorities have noted that available seats for the training program are limited. Interested participants have been advised to reach out promptly through the designated contact numbers provided by the department to secure enrollment and obtain further information.

This specialized course represents part of ongoing regional efforts by the Women Development Department to support female workforce participation. By partnering with hospitality training institutions, the program seeks to bridge the skills gap for women seeking careers in tourism and guest services.

stories.title: بائنانس پر تاریخ کا سب سے بڑا سائبر حملہ، 6.3 ارب ڈالر کے اثاثے متاثر
stories.summary:
دنیا کے سب سے بڑے کرپٹو ایکسچینج بائنانس کو تاریخ کے ممکنہ سب سے بڑے سائبر حملے کا سامنا کرنا پڑا ہے جس میں چھ اعشاریہ تین ارب ڈالر مالیت کے ڈیجیٹل اثاثے متاثر ہوئے ہیں۔ کمپنی کے مطابق دیگر پلیٹ فارمز کے تعاون سے متاثرہ اثاثوں میں سے تقریباً نصف کو منجمد کر دیا گیا ہے اور بائنانس نے تمام نقصانات کا ازالہ کرنے کی مکمل یقین دہانی کرائی ہے۔ ابتدائی تحقیقات سے پتہ چلتا ہے کہ ایک انجینئر کا لیپ ٹاپ ہیک ہونے کے نتیجے میں حملہ آور کو سروس کنٹینر تک رسائی ملی۔ بائنانس کے شریک چیف ایگزیکٹو رچرڈ ٹینگ اور شریک سی ای او یی ہی نے اس سکیورٹی بریچ کی تصدیق کی ہے جبکہ بائنانس ڈاٹ یو ایس کا پلیٹ فارم اس واقعے سے محفوظ رہا ہے۔

دو کرپٹو تجزیاتی اداروں ٹی آر ایم لیبز اور چین انالیسس نے اس حملے کا تعلق شمالی کوریا کے ہیکنگ گروپ سے جوڑا ہے اور کہا ہے کہ اس کی خصوصیات ماضی کے حملوں سے ملتی جلتی ہیں۔ مغربی سکیورٹی اداروں کا ماننا ہے کہ اس طرح کی چوری شدہ رقوم شمالی کوریا کے جوہری اور میزائل پروگراموں کی مالی معاونت کے لیے استعمال ہوتی ہیں، جبکہ شمالی کوریا ماضی میں ایسی تردید کرتا رہا ہے۔ چیک پوائنٹ کے ماہرین کے مطابق یہ حملہ ستمبر میں بٹ گیٹ پر ہونے والے ہیک سے مشابہت رکھتا ہے جس سے یہ ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ ہیکرز کو اب والٹ کی پرائیویٹ کیز کی ضرورت نہیں رہتی بلکہ وہ متعلقہ اختیارات رکھنے والوں کو نشانہ بناتے ہیں۔

بائنانس نے قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے ساتھ قریبی تعاون شروع کر دیا ہے تاکہ مجرموں کا سراغ لگایا جا سکے۔ بلاک چین کے شراکت داروں کے ساتھ مل کر کمپنی نے تین ارب ڈالر مالیت کے اثاثے بلاک چین پر منجمد کر دیے ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ دیگر کرپٹو پلیٹ فارمز بشمول ٹیتھر اور سرکل نے بھی بائنانس ہیک کے ردِعمل میں تقریباً دو اعشاریہ چار ارب ڈالر کے اثاثے منجمد کیے ہیں۔ ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ سے وابستہ کرپٹو کمپنی ورلڈ لبرٹی فنانشل نے بھی چوری شدہ رقوم کو روکنے کے لیے اپنا حصہ ڈالا ہے جبکہ کوائن بیس نے اس واقعے سے محفوظ رہنے کا بیان دیا ہے۔ بائنانس نے صارفین کی سکیورٹی کے پیشِ نظر رقوم نکلوانے کی سہولت عارضی طور پر معطل کر رکھی ہے۔

stories.title: Zee Entertainment Reports 38 Percent Profit Drop Due to FIFA Costs
stories.summary:
Indian broadcaster Zee Entertainment Enterprises announced a 38 percent decline in quarterly profit for the July-September period, driven by expenses tied to the FIFA World Cup broadcast and other corporate initiatives. Consolidated profit dropped to 478 million rupees, equivalent to $5 million, compared to 765 million rupees during the same period in the previous year.

Overall expenses increased by 16 percent, pulling core profit margins down to 3.2 percent from 7.4 percent a year ago. Analysts from Elara Capital had previously indicated that higher promotional and advertising spending would likely weigh heavily on the broadcaster's core margins. Increased programming and advertising costs were specifically attributed to coverage of FIFA, broader content pipelines, and expansion efforts.

Despite the profit dip, subscription revenue grew by 30 percent, aided by subscriber growth linked to FIFA and strong content offerings. Traditional television advertising revenue remained flat, though company officials expressed optimism that the upcoming festive season would provide a much-needed boost to ad spending.

Zee has faced ongoing pressure on its traditional television business as advertisers increasingly shift budgets toward digital platforms. In response to these market changes, the broadcaster has focused on diversification strategies, pouring investments into streaming platforms, sports broadcasting, and vertical-video micro-drama formats.

stories.title: Copper Faces First Monthly Decline Since June Amid AI Spending Anxieties
stories.summary:
Copper prices fell in global markets, heading toward a monthly loss in October as investor risk appetite waned over worries that massive spending on artificial intelligence may fail to deliver adequate returns. On the London Metal Exchange, benchmark three-month copper dropped by 0.9 percent to $14,227 a metric ton, touching a one-week low earlier in the session. This decline contributed to an expected 1 percent monthly drop, driven further by rising oil prices and technology sector jitters that prompted investors to seek safety in bonds.

Despite the broader downward pressure, physical copper markets continued to exhibit tight supply conditions. Persistent backwardation kept the LME cash contract at a premium over the three-month benchmark, reflecting months of inventory flows into United States stocks that depleted metals in traditional hubs. In Asia, the Yangshan copper premium remained close to a 13-year high of $205 a ton, highlighting robust demand in China due to reduced domestic scrap supplies.

Supply chain disruptions also impacted the market, notably in Mongolia where Rio Tinto paused underground activities at the Oyu Tolgoi mine following seismic activity. Additionally, border traffic delays between China and Mongolia restricted the transport of copper concentrate. In other metals, tin dropped 1.9 percent to a six-month low of $48,505 a ton amid similar AI spending concerns, while aluminium, lead, zinc, and nickel showed only minor price fluctuations.

stories.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia Strengthen Energy, Minerals, and Trade Partnership
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Saudi Arabia formally agreed to deepen strategic collaboration across oil storage, refinery modernization, liquefied petroleum gas procurement, and the minerals sector. The agreement was finalized in Islamabad during a meeting between Pakistani Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and the newly appointed Saudi ambassador, Dr Rajeh bin Tami Al-Baqami. Alongside energy arrangements, the Saudi embassy announced the immediate launch of same-day visa processing for Pakistani citizens to foster closer commercial and cultural ties.

To enhance regional energy security, Pakistan introduced a tax-neutral bonded policy designed to let foreign entities establish commercial oil reserves without local tax liabilities. This framework allows Saudi companies to store petroleum in Pakistan, offering a secure route to Asian markets and mitigating maritime transit risks associated with choke points like the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab. Furthermore, Pakistan plans to construct a major petroleum storage and refining complex in Hub, Balochistan, with guidance from Technip Energies UK and support from national leadership.

During the discussions, Minister Malik invited Saudi Arabia’s Vice Minister of Mining, Khalid al-Mudafier, to attend the upcoming Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum in Islamabad. The minister also briefed the envoy on ongoing domestic refinery upgrades aimed at transitioning to Euro-5 fuel standards. Both nations emphasized that their enduring bilateral relationship serves as a cornerstone for regional stability, economic growth, and strategic cooperation.

stories.title: Pakistani Prime Minister Praises Singapore's Economic Transformation During Bilateral Talks
stories.summary:
Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif lauded Singapore’s economic transformation and achievements in innovation during a meeting with visiting Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan in Islamabad. The diplomatic visit coincides with the 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two nations. Prime Minister Sharif reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to deepening bilateral and multilateral ties, particularly through engagement with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, where Singapore is slated to assume the chairmanship in 2027.

Earlier, Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan held extensive delegation-level talks with Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar. During a joint press conference, Dar highlighted the historical ties between the countries and noted that the visit marked the first trip by a Singaporean foreign minister in over two decades. The discussions focused on expanding collaboration in the digital economy, fintech, infrastructure, logistics, artificial intelligence, and education, alongside plans to reopen the Pakistan Trade and Investment Office in Singapore.

Both sides explored measures to enhance business-to-business links, encourage academic exchanges, and possibly resume direct flights to facilitate travel between their populations. Regional and international security matters were also addressed, with an emphasis on securing maritime trade routes and prioritizing dialogue and diplomacy to resolve global challenges. Additionally, concerns regarding the situation in the West Bank and Al-Quds Al-Sharif were raised during the diplomatic engagements.

stories.title: Four Fatally Injured in Azad Kashmir Gas Cylinder Blast
stories.summary:
A tragic gas cylinder explosion at a residential home in Pandi Topi village, located in the Bagh district of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, resulted in four fatalities. The incident occurred around 7:00 PM and claimed the lives of two women, a boy, and a girl inside the residence of Shakdar, son of Sohbat. A 15-year-old girl named Aneeka Shakdar sustained injuries from the blast and was transferred to the District Headquarters Hospital in Bagh for medical care.

While local neighbors reported that a gas cylinder caused the sudden explosion, Bagh police stated that the exact cause and nature of the incident remain under official investigation. Authorities dismissed rumors and false social media reports allegedly spread by elements linked to the banned Joint Awami Action Committee, assuring the public that the formal inquiry will clarify the facts surrounding the tragedy.

In a separate unfortunate event on the same day, an ambulance caught fire following a gas cylinder explosion at a hospital in Nagarparkar, Tharparkar district. That accident resulted in eight deaths after individuals were trapped by the flames, while five others suffered injuries, with three of the wounded admitted to Tehsil Hospital Nagarparkar for treatment.

stories.title: قومی اسمبلی کے اسپیکر کا انتخابی اصلاحات کی پارلیمانی کمیٹی کے لیے خطوط کا ارسال
stories.summary:
قومی اسمبلی کے اسپیکر ایاز صادق نے انتخابی اصلاحات کے لیے ایک پارلیمانی کمیٹی تشکیل دینے کے غرض سے وزیراعظم شہباز شریف، اپوزیشن لیڈر محمود خان اچکزئی، چیئرمین سینیٹ اور وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور کو خطوط ارسال کر دیے ہیں۔ اس مجوزہ کمیٹی کا مقصد آئندہ کے لیے انتخابی عمل میں بہتری لانا اور تمام سیاسی فریقین کے تحفظات کو دور کرنا ہے۔

قومی اسمبلی کے ترجمان کے مطابق یہ انتخابی اصلاحات کمیٹی 30 ارکان پر مشتمل ہوگی، جس میں 20 اراکین قومی اسمبلی اور 10 سینیٹرز شامل ہوں گے۔ قومی اسمبلی کے 20 اراکین میں سے 15 حکومتی اور 5 اپوزیشن سے ہوں گے، جبکہ سینیٹ کے 10 اراکین کے نام چیئرمین سینیٹ حکومت اور اپوزیشن کی نمائندگی کو مدنظر رکھتے ہوئے بھجوائیں گے۔ وفاقی وزیر پارلیمانی امور ڈاکٹر طارق فضل چوہدری نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ قومی اسمبلی سے اس کمیٹی کی تشکیل کی منظوری پہلے ہی دی جا چکی ہے۔

اس حوالے سے پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی نے بھی اہم کردار ادا کیا ہے، جہاں پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری کی ہدایت پر نائب صدر سینیٹر شیری رحمان نے اپوزیشن وفد سے ملاقات کی اور انہیں کمیٹی میں شرکت کی دعوت دی۔ شیری رحمان نے زور دیا کہ اپوزیشن کو اس پارلیمانی عمل کا حصہ بن کر اپنے تحفظات کا کھل کر اظہار کرنا چاہیے کیونکہ کمیٹیاں پارلیمانی امور کا دل ہوتی ہیں۔

اپوزیشن رہنماؤں نے پیپلز پارٹی کے اس وفد کی بات جذبہ خیر سگالی کے تحت سنی ہے اور مشاورت کے بعد جواب دینے کا عندیہ دیا ہے۔ حکومت اور دیگر جماعتیں امید کر رہی ہیں کہ اپوزیشن اس مثبت دعوت کا جواب دے گی تاکہ انتخابی اصلاحات کا عمل اتفاق رائے سے آگے بڑھ سکے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Automaker Sazgar Inaugurates New Three-Wheeler Plant in the Philippines
stories.summary:
Pakistani automotive firm Sazgar Engineering Works Limited has officially opened a brand-new manufacturing facility in Laguna province, Philippines. This strategic launch represents the company's first major expansion into Southeast Asia, successfully broadening its international industrial footprint. The newly established plant possesses the capacity to assemble roughly 12,000 three-wheeled vehicles every year, encompassing both traditional internal combustion engine models and modern electric versions.

Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. attended the inauguration ceremony, emphasizing that the venture aligns with the nation's objective of welcoming businesses that engage in domestic production rather than merely retailing imported goods. Marcos pointed out that this partnership fosters local job creation and opens commercial avenues for domestic suppliers, particularly those providing lubricants, rubber, and battery-related components. Furthermore, the president highlighted that the facility's electric three-wheelers can drive 100 to 210 kilometers on a single charge, permitting a full workday of travel without utilizing gasoline while advancing cleaner public transit.

Originally founded in Pakistan as a private limited company in 1991 before transitioning to a public limited enterprise in 1994, Sazgar operates primary manufacturing plants in Lahore. The company specializes in producing automobiles, auto parts, accessories, tractor wheel rims, and household appliances, and stands as one of Pakistan's prominent rickshaw makers. Sazgar has a history of exporting its three-wheelers globally to regions including Japan, Ethiopia, Qatar, Dubai, Mauritania, Liberia, Tanzania, and Afghanistan.

In September 2025, Sazgar formally announced its strategic intention to scale up its international revenue streams by targeting new export destinations, which specifically included Mexico, Afghanistan, and the Philippines. This latest manufacturing venture in Laguna province crowns those growth efforts. By establishing localized assembly within the Philippines, Sazgar aims to solidify its status as a competitive international exporter while simultaneously aiding the host country's industrial growth and environmental transition objectives.

stories.title: Hackers Steal Record $6.3 Billion from Binance Exchange
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance suffered a record $6.3 billion theft by hackers, an attack analysts attributed to North Korea. Binance paused withdrawals and promised to cover the losses using company funds and reserves, while stablecoin issuers managed to quickly freeze roughly half of the stolen funds.

stories.title: Security Forces Intercept and Destroy Five Drones Targeting Balochistan Check-Post
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces successfully intercepted and destroyed five drones in the Kharan district of Balochistan. According to security sources, the aerial devices were deployed during an attempted attack orchestrated by a group identified as an Indian proxy, Fitna al-Hindustan, which sought to target a military check-post located in the Albat area.

Defense personnel reacted swiftly to the threat, neutralizing all five incoming drones before they could strike their intended objective. Official reports confirmed that the rapid response prevented any damage to local property, and no casualties or loss of life were recorded as a result of the failed strike.

This incident follows a separate aerial interception from the previous month, wherein security sources reported that Pakistan's air defense system shot down eight drones that crossed over the border from Afghanistan. Authorities noted that the nation's air defense grid, managed by the Pakistan Air Force along the Pak-Afghan border, remains on constant alert to counter airspace intrusions.

Tensions related to cross-border security have remained elevated, particularly in regions like Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, following the return of the Afghan Taliban to power in 2021. Islamabad has frequently called upon Kabul to stop militant factions from utilizing Afghan soil for attacks inside Pakistan, while Kabul has consistently disputed these claims. Although the neighboring nations agreed to a ceasefire in October 2025 following border clashes, and subsequently launched Operation Ghazab lil-Haq in February 2026, diplomatic talks have yet to resolve the core disagreements regarding militant sanctuaries.

stories.title: West Indies Take Firm Control Against Bangladesh on Day Three
stories.summary:
West Indies seized command on the third day of the first Test in Mirpur, reducing Bangladesh to 79-6 in their second innings by stumps on Friday. Captain Roston Chase led the bowling onslaught, ripping through the host nation's top order to leave Bangladesh holding a precarious 106-run lead. Concussion substitute Jaker Ali and Nayeem Hasan were both unbeaten on 18 runs when bad light forced an early end to play.

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh was bowled out for 272 in their first innings, securing a narrow 27-run lead over the visiting team. West Indies had resumed their first innings at 134-4, aided by an enduring fifth-wicket partnership between Tagenarine Chanderpaul and Justin Greaves. Chanderpaul top-scored with 56 runs before being caught by captain Najmul Hossain Shanto off Shoriful Islam. Greaves contributed 46 runs before falling lbw to off-spinner Nayeem Hasan, while captain Roston Chase added an unbeaten 43 runs.

Nayeem finished the West Indies' first innings with impressive bowling figures of 4-33, cleaning up the tail by removing Shamar Joseph, Jomel Warrican, and Jayden Seales. This effort restricted the visitors to a total of 245 runs.

In Bangladesh's second innings, fast bowler Shamar Joseph struck immediately in the second over to dismiss opener Tanzid Hasan for a duck. Roston Chase then dismantled the batting lineup further, removing Shadman Islam, Towhid Hridoy, and captain Najmul Hossain Shanto. Additional wickets from Jomel Warrican left the home side struggling at 53-6 before a brief rain interruption and subsequent loss of daylight concluded the day's action.

stories.title: کراچی میں ایل پی جی کی فی کلو قیمت 550 روپے تک پہنچ گئی
stories.summary:
کراچی میں ایل پی جی کی قیمتوں کا بحران شدید ترین شکل اختیار کر گیا ہے جہاں ایک روز کی معمولی کمی کے بعد قیمت میں دوبارہ 50 روپے فی کلو کا اضافہ دیکھا گیا ہے۔ اس تازہ اضافے کے بعد شہر میں ایل پی جی کی فی کلو قیمت 550 روپے تک پہنچ گئی ہے، جو کہ سرکاری نرخ کے مقابلے میں دگنی قیمت پر فروخت ہو رہی ہے۔

مارکیٹ ذرائع کے مطابق اس قیمت میں اضافے کی بنیادی وجہ ایرانی ایل پی جی کی سپلائی کا متاثر ہونا اور مقامی مارکیٹ میں اس کی شدید قلت ہے۔ ایران سے درآمدات رکنے کا فائدہ اٹھاتے ہوئے مقامی مارکیٹنگ کمپنیوں نے سپلائی میں کمی کر دی ہے اور دکانداروں کو مہنگے داموں گیس فراہم کی جا رہی ہے، جس سے تاجروں کا کاروبار بھی بری طرح متاثر ہوا ہے اور فروخت میں پچاس فیصد تک کمی ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔

شہریوں کے لیے یہ صورتحال انتہائی مشکل بن چکی ہے کیونکہ گھروں میں سوئی گیس کی عدم دستیابی کی وجہ سے وہ مہنگے داموں ایل پی جی خریدنے پر مجبور ہیں۔ اس مہنگی گیس کی وجہ سے نہ صرف عام گھریلو بجٹ درہم برہم ہو چکا ہے بلکہ ٹرانسپورٹ کرایوں، تندوروں اور بیکری مصنوعات کی قیمتوں میں بھی اضافہ ہو رہا ہے جس کا سارا بوجھ عوام پر پڑ رہا ہے۔

ماہرین اور مارکیٹ ذرائع کا خدشہ ہے کہ اگر ایرانی ایل پی جی کی سپلائی معمول پر نہ لائی گئی اور حکومتی سطح پر مؤثر نگرانی نہ کی گئی، تو سردیوں کی آمد کے ساتھ ہی اس بحران میں مزید اضافہ ہو سکتا ہے اور عام شہریوں کی مشکلات مزید بڑھ سکتی ہیں۔

stories.title: Meta, TikTok and X Lose Legal Challenge Against UK Regulator Ofcom
stories.summary:
Tech giants Meta, TikTok, and X lost a legal challenge in London’s High Court against British regulator Ofcom regarding data demands issued under the country's Online Safety Act. The 2023 legislation establishes stricter regulatory standards for major digital platforms to protect children from harmful and illegal content, backed by the threat of severe penalties including fines of up to ten percent of a company's global turnover for serious violations.

In February, Ofcom issued information notices requiring the tech companies to supply detailed content moderation metrics. These metrics included specific data tracking how many posts were deleted, how many posts had their visibility restricted, and the number of users exposed to harmful material. 

Meta, TikTok, and X argued in court that the regulator's information notices imposed unprecedented regulatory burdens on their operations. However, London's High Court rejected the case, upholding Ofcom's authority as it progressively implements the new online safety regime. None of the participating technology companies nor the regulator immediately provided comments following the court's ruling.

stories.title: Pakistan Gold Prices Drop Following International Market Declines
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a downward adjustment on Friday, mirroring losses observed in the global market. According to figures provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA), the local rate for gold per tola decreased by Rs5,100, bringing the price to Rs420,536 during the trading day. Prior to this, the price had remained unchanged at Rs425,636 per tola on Thursday.
